verdict.rationale: The Claude Agent SDK is itself an official Anthropic SDK in Python (`pip install claude-agent-sdk`, ClaudeSDKClient) and TypeScript (`@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk` with bundled native binaries). Both have extensive first-party reference docs, a typed options API, an official GitHub repo with code samples, and demo and cookbook examples. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs, and official SDKs beyond Python and TypeScript.
